# TDrive v3.1.0

This update fixes the overlapping search-field borders in the mobile source picker.

It also fixes Linux startup on graphics stacks where WebKitGTK's accelerated
compositing left the application window blank. The Linux launcher now defaults
to WebKitGTK's software rendering path, while allowing an explicit environment
override.

## Mobile source picker

- Keep one consistent outline around the chat search and public-channel link fields.
- Show the focus ring on the field container without drawing a second border inside it.
- Preserve the existing source picker layout and controls.

## Linux rendering

- Avoid blank windows caused by WebKitGTK accelerated compositing failures.
- Keep `WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE` configurable for users who need to override the default.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/ndgthuan/tdrive/compare/v3.0.9...v3.1.0
